name: SOLAR PANEL TEST CHAMBER
desc: Smart Programmable Solar Panel Environmental Climatic Test Chamber engineered for lifespan validation of photovoltaic modules in compliance with IEC 61215:2005 protocols. Features a high-capacity SS304 workspace handling up to 8 solar panels, powered by a French TECUMSEH compressor.
features: Precision structural sizing built to accommodate standard 1 × 2 meter panels
Extended sub-zero and high-heat ranges from minus 60 to 100°C
Extensive moisture injection capabilities spanning from 20 to 98% RH
Fully integrated industrial cascade mechanical compression refrigeration system
Intelligent industrial multi-window color LCD touch screen controller panel

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Smart Programmable Photovoltaic Module Test Chamber
specifications.Primary Testing Framework: Accelerated environmental simulation for solar panel reliability and service life
specifications.Standard Panel Dimensions: Precision structural sizing built to accommodate standard 1 × 2 meter panels
specifications.Chamber Testing Capacity: Flagship multi-rack infrastructure carrying up to 8 panels concurrently
specifications.Thermal Operating Spectrum: Extended sub-zero and high-heat ranges from minus 60 to 100 degrees C
specifications.Temperature Fluctuation Index: Ultra-precise micro-stabilization calibrated within plus or minus 0.5 degrees C
specifications.Temperature Deviation Margin: Consistent multi-position spatial tracking within plus or minus 2.0 degrees C
specifications.Dynamic Humidity Range Scale: Extensive moisture injection capabilities spanning from 20 to 98 percent RH
specifications.Humidity Deviation Limit: High-accuracy moisture equilibrium tracking within plus or minus 2.5 percent RH
specifications.Thermal Transition Change Rate: Rapid temperature transition performance tracking at 1.0 to 3.4 degrees C per minute
specifications.Thermal Sensing Architecture: Industrial-grade integrated high-precision Class A PT100 RTD feedback sensors
specifications.Humidity Sensing Technology: High-durability non-condensing Dry and Wet bulb sensory assembly
specifications.Chamber Air Circulation Loop: Forced air convection vectoring driven by a heavy-duty Centrifugal Blower system
specifications.Core Compliance Protocol 1: Thermal Cycle Test: 50 or 200 fast cycles from minus 40 to plus 85 degrees C (IEC 61215)
specifications.Core Compliance Protocol 2: Humidity Freeze Test: 10 cycles shifting from plus 85 degrees C with 85 percent RH down to minus 40 degrees C
specifications.Core Compliance Protocol 3: Damp Heat Test: Uninterrupted long-term penetration holding 1000 Hours at 85 degrees C with 85 percent RH
specifications.Mechanical Cooling Engine: Fully integrated industrial cascade mechanical compression refrigeration system
specifications.Refrigeration Compressor Unit: Premium low-vibration hermetically sealed French TECUMSEH compressor assembly
specifications.Eco-Safe Cooling Media: Multi-stage environment-safe industrial refrigerants utilizing R404A and R23 loops
specifications.Thermal Generation Element: High-durability fast-response industrial Nichrome armored air heaters
specifications.Primary System Controller: Intelligent industrial multi-window color LCD touch screen controller panel
specifications.Program Profiling Capacity: Heavy memory block supporting 100 distinct programs with 100 segments each
specifications.Data Logging Infrastructure: Inbuilt real-time data recording matrix with Ethernet, PC Link, and USB connectivity
specifications.Chassis Fabrication Material: Heavy-duty rugged Galvanized Steel sheet exterior structure with epoxy powder coat
specifications.Inner Chamber Construction: High-Grade Corrosion-Proof mirror-polished Stainless Steel (SS304 Grade) sheets
specifications.Fluid Feed Automation Deck: Fully automated water supply network with high-precision evaporation systems
specifications.Moisture Stripping Element: High-efficiency industrial evaporator block for precise dehumidification control
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on total logic and compressor matrix
